test_run_task_predictions: test the run_task_predictions function that POSTs to the ML backend predict API endpoint
test_predictions: test running ML predictions on tasks and verify predictions are created with correct results and model versions
test_predictions_with_partially_predicte: test predictions with partially predicted tasks covering outdated, up-to-date, and missing prediction scenarios
test_interactive_annotating: test interactive annotating by sending a task and context to the ML backend and verifying the returned prediction data
test_predictions_meta: test creating and querying PredictionMeta records associated with Prediction and FailedPrediction objects
